name: dark-closet-bikini-selfie
image_purpose: Vacation outfit-check post and getting-ready moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create a raw realistic mirror selfie in a dark modern walk-in closet during a private getting-ready moment.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult Asian woman with long voluminous black-brown hair swept over one shoulder, natural warm makeup, a gentle closed-lip smile, and metallic-blue nails. She wears a black coordinated swim set with secure coverage, subtle starry shimmer, and sheer nude-colored arm sleeves, with thin gold jewelry and a black smartphone held vertically to obscure part of the face.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 mid-thigh-up mirror framing, phone obscuring one eye and cheek, one hand touching hair, weight shifted naturally, loose strands crossing the face. Include matte dark cabinetry, brass rod and hangers, dark cabinet pulls, travel bag, and a slightly cluttered corner.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim ambient closet light with focused warm recessed overhead lights, uneven natural shadows, realistic high-ISO grain, private late-night outfit-check mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone mirror-selfie aesthetic, 9:16, slight downward eye-level reflection, subject mostly sharp with mild background softness, natural skin texture, no studio polish.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A raw realistic 9:16 walk-in-closet mirror selfie of one approved adult Asian woman with long voluminous black-brown hair swept over one shoulder, natural warm makeup, a gentle closed-lip smile, and metallic-blue nails. She wears a black coordinated swim set with secure coverage, subtle starry shimmer, and sheer nude-colored arm sleeves, plus thin gold jewelry, holding a black smartphone vertically so it obscures one eye and cheek. One hand touches her hair and loose strands cross her face. Include matte dark cabinetry, brass rod and hangers, dark cabinet pulls, a travel bag, and a slightly cluttered corner. Warm recessed overhead lights, uneven shadows, natural high-ISO grain, and effortless late-night vacation outfit-check realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, string bikini, transparent garment, sexualized pose, fetish framing, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, studio lighting, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur

assets.name: dark-closet-bikini-selfie.jpg
assets.source: local approved subject, wardrobe, and closet reference
assets.usage: Preserve approved adult identity, hair, safe swim-set styling, sleeves, jewelry, phone position, closet, clutter, lighting, and reflection.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference. Preserve identity, wardrobe intent with secure coverage, phone, hair strands, safe pose, closet environment, and lighting. Hangers, travel bag, and minor clutter may be replaced; do not invent logos or typography. Any replacement person must be an approved adult.

changes: Clarified the subject as an approved adult, replaced string-bikini and sensual body-emphasis wording with a secure coordinated swim set and natural pose, and preserved the dark closet selfie concept.
